_note: Every editorial image slot on the storefront. Swap an image by replacing the file at `src` (same aspect) or pointing `src` at a new file, then flip `placeholder` to false. Product imagery is NOT here — it lives in Square (see docs/content-swap-guide.md). Direction (2026-08-18): the brand is shot and written for women first — she is the buyer, for herself and for the people she buys for. Lead every slot with her; men appear as the gift, never the hero.
